title: OMNI Network 50-Builder Strategic Airdrop & Architecture Memo Distribution
embeddedMemo:
[OMNI NETWORK ECOSYSTEM BUILDER GRANT & ARCHITECTURE MEMO]
Welcome to OMNI Network (Chain ID: 39821)!
You have received an ecosystem builder grant of 500.0 OMNI tokens + 1.0 Native Gas coin to build, test, and integrate.
About OMNI Network & Tokens:
1. Native Gas OMNI: Native EVM gas token on Chain 39821 ($1.00 USD target valuation, sub-cent ~0.000021 OMNI fees).
2. OMNI Token (ERC-20): 0x5FbDB2315678afecb367f032d93F642f64180aa3 (Deflationary governance token with on-chain supply contraction).
3. WOMNI: 0x0355B7B8cb128fA5692729Ab3AAa199C1753f726 (Canonical 1:1 wrapped OMNI for DEX AMM trading).
4. Multi-Asset Liquidity: Live pools for USDC, USDT, WETH (ETH), WBTC with DEX swaps and sOMNI liquid staking (18.5% APY).
DEX Portal: https://omni-network-39821.web.app/swap.html
Block Explorer: https://omni-explorer-39821.web.app
DAO Governance: https://omni-dao-39821.web.app
RPC Gateway: https://omni-rpc-gateway-853859261845.us-central1.run.app
GitHub: https://github.com/X3DevBlake/omni-network
We invite you to deploy contracts, build tools, and partner with the OMNI Network developer ecosystem!
